entities.name: Utba ibn Rabi'ah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Utba ibn Rabi'a, also known as Abu al-Walid was one of the prominent pagan leaders of the Quraysh during the era of Muhammad. He was the father of Abu Hudhayfa, al-Walid, Hind and father-in-law of Abu Sufyan ibn Harb. Utba was killed by Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib in the Battle of Badr.
